column1: # Unit: pptv (parts per trillion by volume)
# Data Source: NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory (1995+); legacy PyAges/TracerLPM reconstruction before 1995
# - Used in electrical equipment and as tracer gas
# - 1995+ values are NOAA GML global monthly means sampled at Jan/Jul (semi-annual)
# - Pre-1995 values retained from the legacy PyAges/TracerLPM reconstruction
# - No direct AGAGE-derived values are identified in the current provenance of this file
# - Latest NOAA combined file date used here: 2023-04-13
# - Recent growth rate has slowed but remains positive
# - Excellent tracer for very young groundwater (< 30 years)
# Extrapolation: Not recommended beyond data range
#   concentration: Atmospheric mole fraction in pptv
